meta.name: linkedin-interviewer
meta.description: Interview the user for the raw material their posts are made of. Builds a lasting Story Bank of roles, numbers, turning points, scars and positions, or runs a focused interview that turns one topic into a post spine. Use when a draft has nothing concrete to draw on, or the user says interview me. Not for learning how they write (use linkedin-humanizer --mode profile).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把你的真实经历、数字和转折点访谈成素材库,让每篇帖子都有具体内容可写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在社交平台发帖却总觉得没东西可写、想让内容带上真实经历
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on social media but keep running out of concrete material to write about

howto.what: Claude 会像访谈者一样向你提问,把你的角色、数字、转折点、立场等素材整理成一份可长期保留的 Story Bank 文件;也可只针对一个话题问 5~8 个问题,最后产出一篇文章骨架。
howto.when: 当你说「采访我」「问我问题」等话术时触发;某篇草稿缺少具体素材、或已有 Story Bank 过期时也会接管。

say.text: 采访我,帮我建一份 Story Bank
say.note: 会分 20~40 分钟提问并写入文件

say.text: 就这个话题采访我,给我一篇文章骨架
say.note: 问 5~8 个问题后把骨架交给写稿技能

say.text: 我换了新岗位,再采访我一次补上空缺部分
say.note: 只问文件里标为单薄的部分

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you to gather the raw material for posts — roles, numbers, turning points, positions — and writes it into a lasting Story Bank file; or runs a 5-8 question interview on one topic and returns a post spine.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "interview me" or "ask me questions", when a draft has nothing concrete to draw on, or when the bank has gone stale. Not for learning your writing style.

say_en.text: Interview me and build a Story Bank
say_en.note: 20-40 min of questions, then writes the file

say_en.text: Interview me on this topic for a post spine
say_en.note: 5-8 questions, then hands the spine off

say_en.text: I changed roles, interview me to fill the gaps
say_en.note: Only asks about sections marked thin
